It's easy to use, but its durability leaves something to be desired.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 3 |durability = 10 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Hunter's Shield}} Hunter's Shields are wooden [[Shield]]s similar to the [[Emblazoned Shield]] and [[Fisherman's Shield]]. They are favored by hunters for their rabbit designs, which are said to bring luck. Hunter's Shields, like [[Wooden Shield]]s, have low defensive power, but they are known to be easy to use. There are three places to find Hunter's Shields. One is in a [[Treasure Chest]] near a lake below [[Lanayru Tower]]. There is another in the east side of the [[North Lomei Labyrinth]], and it will respawn after some time. Finally, [[Selmie]] gives one out as a reward for completing the [[Shield-Surfing (Mini-Game)|Shield-Surfing]] [[Mini-Game]] in between 3:15 and 3:30.{{Cite|A shiny new record deserves a shiny new shield. Here y'go!|Selmie|BotW}} Female [[Hylian]] travelers are known to wield them as well, allowing [[Link]] to take a [[Picture]] of them for the [[Hyrule Compendium]]. Hunter's Shields are made of wood, and they will therefore burn if they are exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s like metal Shields do.
